subtitleFa: if + had + pp, would have + pp

steps.intro: if + had + past participle, would have + past participle — گذشتهٔ غیرواقعی + پشیمانی.

examples.en: If I had studied, I would have passed.
examples.fa: اگر درس خوانده بودم قبول می‌شدم (نشدم).

examples.en: If she had known, she would have told you.
examples.fa: اگر می‌دانست به تو می‌گفت.

examples.en: If it had rained, we would have stayed home.
examples.fa: اگر باران آمده بود خانه می‌ماندیم.

examples.en: I would have called if I had had your number.
examples.fa: اگر شماره‌ات را داشتم زنگ می‌زدم.

steps.note: if-clause → had + pp · main clause → would have + pp

mistake.wrong: If I would have studied, I would have passed.
mistake.right: If I had studied, I would have passed.
mistake.whyFa: در if-clause، «would have» نمی‌آید؛ فقط had + pp.

items.prompt: If I ___ harder, I would have passed.
جای خالی را پر کن:
items.sentence: If she ___ (know), she would have told you.

items.prompt: I would have called if I ___ your number.

steps.intro: در if-clause، گذشتهٔ کامل (had + pp) به کار می‌رود.

examples.en: If you had asked, I would have helped.
examples.fa: اگر خواسته بودی کمک می‌کردم.

examples.en: If they had left earlier, they wouldn't have missed the train.
examples.fa: اگر زودتر رفته بودند قطار را از دست نمی‌دادند.

examples.en: If I had seen him, I would have said hello.
examples.fa: اگر او را دیده بودم سلام می‌کردم.

examples.en: If it had rained, we would have stayed home.
examples.fa: اگر باران آمده بود خانه می‌ماندیم.

mistake.wrong: If you asked, I would have helped.
mistake.right: If you had asked, I would have helped.

items.prompt: جای خالی را پر کن:
items.sentence: If you ___ (ask), I would have helped.

items.prompt: If they ___ earlier, they wouldn't have missed the train.
جای خالی را پر کن:
items.sentence: If I ___ (see) him, I would have said hello.

steps.intro: در جملهٔ اصلی، would have + past participle.

examples.en: If I had known, I would have called you.
examples.fa: اگر می‌دانستم زنگ می‌زدم.

examples.en: She wouldn't have come if she had known.
examples.fa: اگر می‌دانست نمی‌آمد.

examples.en: They would have stopped if they had seen the sign.
examples.fa: اگر علامت را دیده بودند ایستاده بودند.

examples.en: I would have bought it if I had had money.
examples.fa: اگر پول داشتم می‌خریدم.

steps.note: main clause → would have + pp (نه would + pp).

mistake.wrong: If I had known, I would called you.
mistake.right: If I had known, I would have called you.

items.prompt: If I had known, I ___ you.
جای خالی را پر کن:
items.sentence: She ___ (would / not / come) if she had known.

items.prompt: They ___ if they had seen the sign.

steps.intro: type 3 همیشه پشیمانی یا نتیجهٔ نگرفته دارد.

examples.en: If I hadn't eaten so much, I wouldn't have felt sick.
examples.fa: اگر اینقدر غذا نمی‌خوردم حالم بد نمی‌شد.

examples.en: If I had studied, I would have passed.
examples.fa: اگر درس خوانده بودم قبول می‌شدم.

examples.en: If she hadn't left, she would have met him.
examples.fa: اگر نرفته بود او را می‌دید.

examples.en: If only I had listened to you!
examples.fa: ای کاش به تو گوش داده بودم!

steps.note: If only + had + pp = تأکید قوی‌ترِ پشیمانی.

mistake.wrong: If I hadn't eaten so much, I wouldn't feel sick (past).
mistake.right: If I hadn't eaten so much, I wouldn't have felt sick.

items.prompt: کدام جمله پشیمانی گذشته را نشان می‌دهد؟
options: If I had studied, I would have passed.
If I study, I will pass.
If I studied, I would pass.

items.prompt: I ___ so tired if I had slept more.
جای خالی را پر کن:
items.sentence: If I ___ (not / eat) so much, I wouldn't have felt sick.

steps.titleFa: could / might have در main clause
steps.intro: به جای would، می‌توان could یا might هم آورد.

examples.en: If I had studied, I could have passed.
examples.fa: می‌توانستم قبول شوم (توانایی).

examples.en: I might have passed if I had studied.
examples.fa: شاید قبول می‌شدم (احتمال).

examples.en: She could have won if she had trained.
examples.fa: می‌توانست ببرد اگر تمرین کرده بود.

examples.en: He might have come if you had invited him.
examples.fa: شاید می‌آمد اگر دعوتش کرده بودی.

steps.note: would = نتیجهٔ قطعی · could = توانایی · might = احتمال

mistake.wrong: If he had trained, he could won.
mistake.right: If he had trained, he could have won.

items.prompt: If he had trained, he ___ won.
جای خالی را پر کن:
items.sentence: If she had asked, I ___ (might / help).

items.prompt: If I had known, I ___ come.

steps.intro: type 2 = حال غیرواقعی · type 3 = گذشتهٔ غیرواقعی.

examples.en: If I were rich, I would travel.
examples.fa: اگر ثروتمند بودم سفر می‌کردم (الان نیستم).

examples.en: If I had been rich, I would have traveled.
examples.fa: اگر ثروتمند بودم سفر می‌کردم (گذشته).

examples.en: If she worked harder, she would pass.
examples.fa: اگر سخت‌تر کار می‌کرد قبول می‌شد (حال).

examples.en: If she had worked harder, she would have passed.
examples.fa: اگر سخت‌تر کار کرده بود قبول می‌شد (گذشته).

steps.note: اگر نتیجه مربوط به گذشته است → type 3 · اگر حال است → type 2

mistake.wrong: If I had studied, I would be a doctor now.
mistake.right: If I had studied, I would have passed. (گذشته، type 3)
mistake.whyFa: اگر نتیجه هم گذشته باشد → type 3.

items.prompt: کدام جمله type 3 است؟
options: If I were rich, I would travel.
If I had been rich, I would have traveled.
If I am rich, I will travel.

items.prompt: If she ___ harder, she would have passed.
جای خالی را پر کن:
items.sentence: If I ___ (not / be) sick, I would have gone.

steps.intro: ۱۲ تمرین متنوع. بعضی جمله‌ها درست هستند و نباید اصلاح شوند.
steps.note: هر سؤال را می‌توانی رد کنی.

options: If I had studied, I would have passed.
If I would have studied, I would have passed.

items.why: در if-clause، would have نمی‌آید؛ فقط had + pp.
